on time = at the correct time, not late
assembly = a meeting of the whole school, often in the hall
break = a short rest between two lessons
lunch break = the longer midday rest when students eat
after-school club = an activity at school after lessons finish
homework diary = a small book for writing down homework
exercise book = a book of empty pages for writing schoolwork
textbook = the main book used for a subject
workbook = a book of printed exercises
worksheet = a single paper with exercises
folder = a cover for keeping loose papers together
pencil case = a small bag for pens and pencils
rubber = a small object for removing pencil marks
ruler = a straight tool for drawing lines and measuring
highlighter = a bright pen for marking important words
glue stick = a stick of glue for paper
scissors = a tool with two blades for cutting paper
interactive whiteboard = a large computer screen the teacher writes on
computer lab = a room full of computers for lessons
science lab = a room for experiments
